name: Fallen Memory
detailed_description:
If Reality is Distorted, How Can You Trust Your Past?

Fallen Memory invites players into a world where darkness and uncertainty reign. Alan awakens in an unfamiliar house with no memory of who he is—only the feeling that he doesn’t belong here. In this place, mirrors refuse to reflect the truth, and every door leads to a different face of the unknown. Alan’s only path forward is through the shadowy maze of his forgotten past.

This semi-cinematic psychological horror experience is woven with forgotten memories, regrets, and truths hidden in the dark. In this nightmare where mind and space collide, players will explore a haunting atmosphere, follow traces of a shattered memory, and confront the darkness within themselves.

Fallen Memory tells the story of a soul bound by sins long buried. But redemption is in your hands…

You can’t escape your past. Because sometimes, the past... is you.

short_description: Alan, who cannot remember his past, wakes up in a dark house caught between reality and illusion. Mirrors lie, rooms shift. In this psychological horror game, you must trace lost memories and face dark truths along with your mental collapse.
